5-star hotel prices in Canada, Latin America and the Caribbean: 175 hotels across booking sites

The 175 hotels in Canada, Latin America and the Caribbean that Google Hotels listed as a 5-star hotel, in 34 cities. Each line shows the hotel's going rate and the lowest price we recorded across the booking sites Google Hotels listed, per night, all-in where the sites reported taxes and fees, from its city's snapshot. Each hotel's page has every site's price. The going rate is the price the largest number of listings that named a room or offered free cancellation agreed on (ties go to the lower price).

At 156 of the 175 hotels, a site was 5% or more below the going rate on its page (all-in where the sites reported taxes and fees); the sites lowest there most often: Super.com (53 hotels), Billabook.com and Evendo (13 hotels each), Traveluro (11 hotels). A tie counts for each site.

Other star classes in Canada, Latin America and the Caribbean: 4-star · 3-star · 1- and 2-star · No star class listed. Every city we priced in Canada, Latin America and the Caribbean.
